status: design-only; test specifications not implemented or executed
event_envelopes: supplied exact intervals for area-layer tests; tracker extraction separately reviewed

cases.setup: resolved pair envelopes for A end before B starts; each patch below quarter; each four completions in W
cases.rationale: Known pooling counterexample; no positive-duration concurrency

cases.setup: two sub-quarter patches overlap in duration; all completion frames differ; four completions per pixel
cases.rationale: Concurrency must not depend on shared completion timestamp

cases.setup: two sub-quarter patches share all four excursion intervals
cases.rationale: Positive area and frequency control

cases.setup: reverse bright/dark polarity of separated and overlapping schedules
cases.rationale: Temporal support includes both polarity directions

cases.setup: three completions per pixel even where instantaneous area exceeds quarter
cases.rationale: Preserve existing count rule

cases.setup: four completions at 0, 333, 666, 1000 ms; evaluate t=1000; supports overlap sufficiently
cases.rationale: Compatibility: inclusive left endpoint counts four

cases.setup: same completions; evaluate t=1000.001 ms
cases.rationale: Compatibility: completion 0 lies outside W

cases.setup: same completions; evaluate t=999.999 ms
cases.rationale: Fourth completion has not occurred

cases.setup: completion is inside W; support begins before W
cases.rationale: Retain count; compare overlap inside W, while documenting frequency-convention ambiguity

cases.setup: qualified second threshold crossing is inside W; final extreme still unknown after t
cases.rationale: Do not truncate support at the completion timestamp

cases.setup: resolved interval A ends exactly at B start; neither alone exceeds quarter
cases.rationale: Half-open proposed convention: zero-duration coincidence is not overlap

cases.setup: exact event-table envelopes overlap for 0.001 ms and combined area exceeds quarter; counts qualify
cases.rationale: No new minimum overlap duration

cases.setup: sample brackets overlap even though nominal endpoints only touch
cases.rationale: Use conservative envelope, not central estimate

cases.setup: threshold confirmation occurs before final return extreme; overlap occurs in that tail
cases.rationale: Shortening to completion would be a false negative

cases.setup: small reversal occurs within a pending pair; no resolved envelope mapping yet
cases.rationale: Define event-boundary state contract before asserting suppression

cases.setup: starting or return extreme persists across many frames
cases.rationale: Approve departure/final-extreme convention; unresolved case falls back

cases.setup: file ends while a relevant qualified event support is unresolved
cases.rationale: No zero-duration event or silent event drop

cases.setup: neutral-light pulses independently satisfy general rule and not red rule
cases.rationale: Run real general tracker plus overlap layer

cases.setup: verified linear-light color pair satisfies existing red rule; independently show general rule is not met
cases.rationale: Run real red tracker; no assumed RGB pair

cases.setup: same signal qualifies under both general and red rules
cases.rationale: Do not double-count pixels; preserve red reason and opaque cover

cases.setup: two general-only and two red-only completions at a pixel in W
cases.rationale: Do not merge counts across kinds

cases.setup: repeat four qualifying excursions on exactly 576, 121, or 5184 pixels in the respective window
cases.rationale: Area limit is strictly greater than one quarter

cases.setup: repeat four qualifying excursions on 577, 122, or 5185 pixels in the respective window
cases.rationale: One pixel above the unchanged area limit

cases.setup: two event records include same pixel at same time
cases.rationale: Distinct event count may matter; spatial area must not double-count

cases.setup: translate equivalent mask within legal frame bounds
cases.rationale: Use every spatial placement, not a fixed origin

cases.setup: largest patches occur in different window placements at different times
cases.rationale: Never add independent maxima across time or position

cases.setup: evaluate baseline alone and with room appended
cases.rationale: Added room cannot remove baseline result; broadcast screen retained

cases.setup: same numeric frames whole, chunked, overlapping chunks
cases.rationale: Retain timestamp deduplication and pending state

cases.setup: nonuniform timestamps with same prescribed pulse supports
cases.rationale: Use PTS, not frame counts or assumed FPS

cases.setup: relevant envelope missing or evidence cannot be retained
cases.rationale: No silent eviction or permissive result

cases.setup: A has four early completions in W, then a pending fifth excursion overlapping B fourth excursion; completion of A fifth is after t
cases.rationale: Do not exclude pending support on an already frequency-eligible pixel

cases.setup: Four completions qualify a pixel in W; another qualified event completes outside W but its conservative support intersects W
cases.rationale: Frequency count and temporal support require separate retention indexes

color_vector_scope: Synthetic AnalysisFrame inputs. sRGB channels are encoded from the supplied linear RGB; video_level is explicitly set to 0.2126 R_srgb + 0.7152 G_srgb + 0.0722 B_srgb. This is a deterministic input convention for unit tests, not a claim about real decoding or BT.709 transfer conversion.
